messages.subject: Distance 3.5 Install problems
parts:
To Distance 3.5 users:

Has anyone experienced the following problem?

- You install Distance 3.5 apparently without problems
- When you come to run it, you get
Run-time error '91'
Object variable or With block variable not set

If so, please contact me (dist...@mcs.st-and.ac.uk). Two people so far have
reported this problem to me, but I can't reproduce it on any of our machines
here, so I don't know how to go about fixing it.

Thanks,

- Len Thomas



--
Len Thomas, Co-ordinator
Distance Development Project
Research Unit for Wildlife Population Assessment
Mathematical Institute, University of St Andrews
Scotland
